shapeSummary: Simplified 96 mm diameter wheel with its axis along Z, 24 mm wide and centered at X=0, Z=0, with its lowest point at Y=0. One face (+Z) has an annular recess (outer Ø80, inner Ø44, 10 mm deep) around a raised central hub. A Ø16 central bore passes through the whole wheel. The tread is modeled as a plain cylinder with the plastic core and rubber as one solid.
warnings: The 24 mm width is a visual estimate and is not stated in the source.
The bore diameter (16 mm), recess diameters and recess depth are estimated from the image.
The mounting-hole pattern on the hub and rim is omitted because positions and diameters are unknown.
Spokes and triangular ribs are omitted as uncertain decorative or structural detail.
Tread grooves along the outer edge are omitted.
The plastic core and rubber tread are merged into a single solid.
The yellow ring and printed text are not modeled, as required.
The analysis JSON puts the axis along Z, so the wheel center sits at Y=48 to keep the bottom at Y=0.
